import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots for comprehensive customer segmentation insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Calculate total spending for each customer
df['TotalSpending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                       df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])

# Calculate age
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']

# 1. Income Distribution by Education Level
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
education_order = df.groupby('Education')['Income'].median().sort_values().index
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='Education', x='Income', order=education_order, palette='Set2', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Education', fontsize=11)

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=30, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.axvline(df['Age'].median(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Median: {df["Age"].median():.0f}')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Spending by Category
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
spending_categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                       'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
category_totals = df[spending_categories].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
category_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
category_dict = dict(zip(spending_categories, category_labels))
colors = plt.cm.Spectral(np.linspace(0.2, 0.8, len(category_totals)))
ax3.barh([category_dict[cat] for cat in category_totals.index], category_totals.values, color=colors)
ax3.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Product Category', fontsize=10)

# 4. Income vs Total Spending Scatter
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:])
scatter = ax4.scatter(df['Income'], df['TotalSpending'], 
                     c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', alpha=0.6, s=30)
ax4.set_title('Income vs Total Spending (colored by Age)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=10)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=10)

# 5. Purchase Channel Comparison
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
channel_data = df[['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']].sum()
channels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store']
colors_pie = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1']
ax5.pie(channel_data.values, labels=channels, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax5.set_title('Purchase Channel Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Family Structure (Kids + Teens at home)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
df['TotalChildren'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
children_counts = df['TotalChildren'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax6.bar(children_counts.index, children_counts.values, color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_title('Distribution of Children at Home', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Number of Children', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Customers', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_xticks(range(int(children_counts.index.max()) + 1))

# 7. Campaign Response Rate
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
campaigns = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
response_rates = [df[camp].sum() / len(df) * 100 for camp in campaigns]
campaign_labels = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Last']
colors_bar = plt.cm.RdYlGn(np.linspace(0.3, 0.8, len(campaigns)))
ax7.bar(campaign_labels, response_rates, color=colors_bar, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax7.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Campaign', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Acceptance Rate (%)', fontsize=10)
ax7.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
